questions.question: The bar graph given below shows the expenditure of two companies L and M in different years. Which of the following statement is correct? I. The expenditure of company L in Y2 is 33.33 percent of the expenditure of M in year Y3. II. The expenditure of company M in year Y5 is 100 percent of the expenditure of L in year Y4.
questions.questionHtml:
The bar graph given below shows the expenditure of two companies L and M in different years.

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The expenditure of company L in Y2 is 33.33 percent of the expenditure of M in year Y3.

II. The expenditure of company M in year Y5 is 100 percent of the expenditure of L in year Y4.
questions.solution:
Statement I:

Percentage of the expenditure of company L in Y2 to the expenditure of M in year Y3 = 400/600 × 100 = 66.66%

Statement II:

Percentage of the expenditure of company M in Y5 to the expenditure of L in year Y4 = 300/300 × 100 = 100%

Statement I is wrong but Statement II is correct..

questions.question: Number of male and female members in different organizations A, B, C, D and E are given in the bar graph. What is the ratio of average number of females in all the five organizations to the average number of males in all the five organizations?

questions.solution:
Calculation:

Total number of males in all the five organizations = (250 + 225 + 325 + 275 + 150)

⇒ 1225

Average number of males in all the five organizations = 1225/5 = 245

Total number of females in all the five organizations = (300 + 275 + 250 + 200 + 125)

Required ratio = 230 : 245

questions.question: Study the following graph and answer the given question. The graph shows the time (in minutes) taken by the pipes (A, B), (C, D), (E, F), (G, H), and (P, Q) to fill a tank. Two pipes P and Q are inlet pipes. If they are opened at alternate minutes and if pipe P is opened first, then in how many minutes will the tank be full?
questions.questionHtml:
Study the following graph and answer the given question.

The graph shows the time (in minutes) taken by the pipes (A, B), (C, D), (E, F), (G, H), and (P, Q) to fill a tank.

Two pipes P and Q are inlet pipes. If they are opened at alternate minutes and if pipe P is opened first, then in how many minutes will the tank be full?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Time taken by P to fill the tank = 15 minutes

P's 1 minute work = 1/15 

Time taken by Q to fill the tank = 30 minutes

Q's 1 minute work = 1/30

Now, they are opened at alternate minutes

In 2 minutes = 1/15 + 1/30 = 3/30 = 1/10 tank is filled 

Time taken to completely fill the tank = 2 × 10 = 20 minutes

Students from school A in the year 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012 and 2013 is 640, 800, 500, 700, 500 and 750 respectively.

Average = sum of all entry/Total number of entry

Calculation:

The average of total students from school B is (550 + 820 + 600 + 750 + 500 + 480)/6

questions.question: Direction: Study the following graph and answer the question given below. What is the ratio of the total amount invested by Vivek in schemes A and C together to the total amount invested by Shalini in schemes A and C together?
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Study the following graph and answer the question given below.

What is the ratio of the total amount invested by Vivek in schemes A and C together to the total amount invested by Shalini in schemes A and C together?
questions.solution:
Confusion Points 

In the 2nd tabulation, it is written that the percentage of Vivek's investment is out of the total investment. If I want to find Shalini's investment. I will subtract Vivek's investment from the total investment.  we can say that  

Shalini's investment.= 100% - vivek investment

Detailed solution:-

Total amount invested by Vivek and Shalini in scheme A = 80,000

Total amount invested by Vivek and Shalini in scheme C = 30,000

The total amount invested by Vivek in schemes A and C together = 50% of 80,000 + 40% of 30,000

⇒ 40,000 + 12,000

⇒ 52,000 

Shalini's investment.= 100% - vivek investment

The total amount invested by Shalini in schemes A and C together = (100 - 50)% of 80,000 + (100 - 40)% of 30,000

⇒ 40,000 + 18,000

⇒ 58,000

Therefore, required ratio = 52,000: 58,000 = 26:29

questions.question: The following bar graph shows the data of the production of an item (in thousand tonnes) from four different companies A, B, C and D during the years mentioned. In the five years given, the average production is highest in company _________ and lowest in company __________, respectively.
questions.questionHtml:
The following bar graph shows the data of the production of an item (in thousand tonnes) from four different companies A, B, C and D during the years mentioned.

In the five years given, the average production is highest in company _________ and lowest in company __________, respectively.
questions.solution:
Average production by company A = (23 + 26 + 28 + 25 + 30)/5

⇒ 26.4      

Average production by company B = (25 + 29 + 27 + 35 + 31)/5

⇒ 29.4

Average production by company C = (28 + 31 + 36 + 28 + 35)/5

⇒ 31.6

Average production by company D = (32 + 35 + 40 + 46 + 50)/5

⇒ 40.6

We can clearly see that, 

Highest average production = D

Lowest average production = A

∴ The average production is highest in company D and lowest in the company A.

questions.question: The following graph shows the wheat imports (in thousand tonnes) over the five years: What is the ratio of the years which have below-average imports to those which have above-average imports?
questions.questionHtml:
The following graph shows the wheat imports (in thousand tonnes) over the five years: 

What is the ratio of the years which have below-average imports to those which have above-average imports?
questions.solution:
Given:

Wheat imports (in thousand tonnes) for five years: 36 (2018), 32 (2019), 34 (2020), 37 (2021), 35 (2022)

Formula used:

Average imports = Sum of imports / Number of years

Calculation:

⇒ Average imports = (36 + 32 + 34 + 37 + 35) / 5 = 174 / 5 = 34.8 thousand tonnes

Below-average imports: 2019 (32), 2020 (34)

Above-average imports: 2018 (36), 2021 (37), 2022 (35)

Ratio of below-average to above-average imports = 2:3

∴ The correct answer is option (2).

questions.question: The given bar graph represents the number of boys and girls in five different schools. Study the graph and answer the question that follows. What is the ratio of girls and boys from all the schools taken together?
questions.questionHtml:
The given bar graph represents the number of boys and girls in five different schools. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

What is the ratio of girls and boys from all the schools taken together?
questions.solution:
Given:

Total number of girls = 500 + 550 + 650 + 600 + 650 = 2950

Total number of boys = 600 + 450 + 750 + 700 + 800 = 3300

Concept used:

Using the concept of ratio.

Calculation:

Required ratio = Total number of girls ∶ Total number of boys

⇒ Required ratio = 2950 ∶ 3300

⇒ Required ratio = 59 ∶ 66

∴ The ratio of girls and boys from all the schools taken together is 59 ∶ 66.

questions.question: The following bar graph shows the sales (in thousands) of magazines from six branches (A, B, C, D, E and F) of a publishing company during two consecutive years 2021 and 2022. What percent of the average sales of branches A, B and C in 2022 is the average sales of branches A, C and F in 2021?
questions.questionHtml:
The following bar graph shows the sales (in thousands) of magazines from six branches (A, B, C, D, E and F) of a publishing company during two consecutive years 2021 and 2022.

What percent of the average sales of branches A, B and C in 2022 is the average sales of branches A, C and F in 2021?
questions.solution:
Average sales (in thousand number) of branches A, C, and F in 2021

= 1/3 × (80 + 95 + 70) = (245 ⁄ 3)

Average sales (in thousand number) of branches A, B, and C in 2022

= 1/3 × (105 + 65 + 110) = (280 ⁄ 3)

Required percentage = \(\frac{\frac{245}{3}}{\frac{280}{3}} \times 100\) % = (245 ⁄ 280 × 100)% = 87.5%

questions.question: A Chocolate company prepares three different kinds of chocolate - X, Y and Z. The production of X, Y and Z over a period of five years has been expressed in the bar graph. The total production of Z in 2017 and 2018 is what percentage of the total production of X in 2020 and 2021?
questions.questionHtml: A Chocolate company prepares three different kinds of chocolate - X, Y and Z. The production of X, Y and Z over a period of five years has been expressed in the bar graph. The total production of Z in 2017 and 2018 is what percentage of the total production of X in 2020 and 2021?
questions.solution:
The total production of Z in 2017 and 2018 = 50579 + 44456 = 95035

The total production of X in 2020 and 2021 = 175128 + 157279 = 332407

Percentage = 95035/332407 × 100 = 28.59%
